SELECT g.id, g.name, g.description, g.cover, g.shoot_date AS shootDate, g.create_time AS createdAt, COUNT(p.id) AS photoCount FROM t_gallery g LEFT JOIN t_photo p ON p.gallery_id = g.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0
AND (g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.description, g.cover, g.shoot_date, g.create_time, g.sort ORDER BY g.sort ASC, g.create_time DESC, g.id DESC
